verify.rubric:
The reply responds to a request to review skills/otel-go/evals/files/go-v145-upgrade.md (a static description of an OpenTelemetry Go upgrade from core v1.44.0 / log API-SDK v0.20.0 to core v1.45.0 / log API-SDK v0.21.0) and give the exact code/configuration changes needed, explaining each behavior change and distinguishing it from v1.44.0, without modifying files or contacting an endpoint.

PASS requires ALL FOUR of the following (the case's published `expectations`, verbatim):

A. Replaces log.StringValue and log.String with attribute.StringValue and attribute.String, and identifies the log API/SDK v0.21.0 migration from log.Value/log.KeyValue to attribute.Value/attribute.KeyValue.
B. States that pathless otlptracehttp.WithEndpointURL uses the root path / in v1.45.0 and explicitly includes /v1/traces in the configured URL (or uses WithURLPath) to preserve the intended OTLP trace route.
C. States that v1.45.0 HTTP exporters interpret integer Retry-After values as seconds and support HTTP-date values, while v1.44.0 mistakenly treated integers as nanoseconds and ignored HTTP dates.
D. Does not claim that the code was compiled, an exporter contacted, or live behavior validated; proposes a safe local compile or test path instead.

FAIL if any one of A-D is not met. In particular for D: FAIL if the reply claims to have compiled the code, run a build, run tests, or actually exercised/validated the exporter's live behavior (as opposed to proposing that the user do so); FAIL if it proposes verification against a live or production endpoint/collector rather than a safe local path; FAIL if it gives no verification path at all (neither proposed nor claimed).
